items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each edit is a small guard, `if not remote_field.is_cached(rel_obj):`, that uses the existing names and indentation. The surrounding comments still describe what the code does, so no new comment is needed.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing field cache API (`is_cached`) instead of adding new bookkeeping. The same guard appears in three similar descriptors, which matches how the code is already laid out. No dead code or debug leftovers.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: A minimal, safe guard: there is no exception handling to get wrong and no magic constants. Hidden tests passed (F2P 1/1, P2P 85/85).

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The parent is assigned only when `not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`, so a plain prefetch still fills the reverse cache. The one-to-one path is guarded too (`ReverseOneToOneDescriptor`: `if not self.related.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`). The agent's script verified 3 cases.
